name: Table 1-1 Sub-rolls (per-feature effect cascades)
_doc: Each feature on Table 1-1 has a sub-effect cascade. This file collects those cascades. Some features pick ONE effect (Gravity Tides, Haven, Ruined Empire), some pick ONE-OR-MORE (Bountiful, Ill-Omened, Warp Stasis -- roll each option independently with a uniform random selection that may pick multiple). Used by generate_system_features() to populate the feature_flags struct.

options.description: 1 extra Asteroid Belt OR Cluster (5+ on 1d10 = Belt, else Cluster)
On 6+ on 1d10 per asteroid belt/cluster, roll 1d5 extra times on Table 1-20 Mineral Resources for that body
1 extra roll on Table 1-20 per Planet generated
Chance of extra Exotic Material per Planet
Add 1d5 Gravity Riptides to the System (placeable in any Solar Zone)
Safely entering orbit requires a Difficult (-10) Pilot (Space Craft) Test; small craft Very Hard (-30) Pilot (Flyers)
Travel between Planets within this System takes half the usual time
1 additional Planet in each Solar Zone
Primary Biosphere planets have thicker atmospheres (roll Table 1-9 with +2)
Primary Biosphere planets have better habitability (roll Table 1-12 with +2)
When spending a Fate Point within this System, roll 1d10. On a 9, it has no effect.
All Willpower Tests made within this System are at -10
Insanity Points gained within this System are doubled
Divination Discipline psychic-exploration use requires a Difficult (-10) Fear Test before the Focus Power Test
1d5+4 Wolfpack Raiders led by a stronger flagship (often a Frigate). Never <5, rarely >8. Alternative fleets: Ork/Eldar/Rak'Gol/Chaos vessels of higher quality.
Add 1d5-1 (min 1) extra Xenos Ruins on different planets; abundance bonus to existing Xenos Ruins resources
Add 1d5-1 (min 1) extra Archeotech Caches on different planets; abundance bonus to existing Archeotech resources
Minimum 4 Planets in this System after all modifiers
1d5+3 System Features are inhabited by the starfaring civilisation
-2 to the final Planet count (this System has unusually few Planets due to the anomaly)
Focus Power and Psyniscience Tests within the System are at -10
Psychic Techniques cannot be used at the Push level within the System
When rolling on Psychic Phenomena, roll twice and use the lower result
1 Planet in the System is engulfed in a permanent Warp storm
